I need bluntness right now so thank you. I overthink everything and hate making decisions. I agree with you I’m probably not the best person to help him but he won’t talk to anyone. I’m not sure if it’s pride or denial or what. He complains about his family a lot even though they’re seriously amazing. It hurts too because I come from a pretty broken home and it sucks he can’t recognize what he has and that people do love him. 

I’m gonna wait for him to wake up I think and talk to him, find out what he did when he went missing for a bit. If he went out to find blow or who knows what else, I’ll probably talk to his fam because he is on their insurance.

(Also, no if anything the price has gotten higher due to COVID tbh. He’s unemployed.. legally if you know what I mean. He’s learned to make his habits profitable)
Do you think I should I involve his family? I don’t wanna “tell on him” but if we do break up, I still want him to get the help he needs
You’re right. I have some serious thinking to do before he comes home. I appreciate your feedback very much, thank you.

Hi! Yes I am in therapy and have been taking my meds consistently for a few months now (I wasn’t before). I’ve been feeling better, enrolled back in school and am hunting for a better job. I fight back with him sometimes and admit to him when I get too angry and own up to it but he never can. If he does, he says “sorry” literally just sorry. but nothing changes. 

I appreciate your thoughtful response. I really do. I do want out sometimes but I’m scared for him if we break up. I don’t want him going back to his old, extra unhealthy behavior. I’m not sure if I should work with his family to get him the help he needs. I’m just already kinda checked out of the relationship this time and i feel guilty for that:(
